title: Organic Title Controls, Frontend Music, and Rounded Water Depth Rendering
notes: The Z55 workstation build passed workspace Cargo check and strict Clippy and reached the complete workspace test suite.
Title hover and pressed feedback now use an alpha-masked overlay derived from the accepted scenic title controls; no rectangular hover frame is drawn.
The frontend owns a real looping music handle at 40 percent volume and stops it when gameplay launches.
An asset-only bootstrap verifies or restores the attributed historical Harp.ogg by exact SHA-256 without rewriting Rust source.
Pond and ocean shallow-to-deep contours use a dedicated WaterRenderMask and complete authored LPC depth edge/corner cells for common masks.
Semantic hydrology, marine/freshwater identity, minimum deep-core rules, sand policy, title artwork, rocks, clothing, and save schemas are preserved.
